shared_elements: rows of repeated short vertical strokes (crew-like or offering-like series)
justification: A shows human figures with headdresses, offering tables and dense script-like signs arranged in stacked registers, whereas B shows a single large boat-like hull with an internal grid of lines and a fringe of short vertical strokes below. The only correspondence is the generic use of incised outline drawing with horizontal dividing lines and rows of repeated short vertical marks; the subject matter (figural offering scene vs. abstract vessel) is entirely different.
